material_model: Reduced fixed-topology prepared knot, not full cloth or tying from scratch
metadata_only_differences: Final descriptive setup/fidelity, scores, media and documentation were completed after the runs. Instruction and all runtime Python/plan hashes match.

visual_review.method: Sampled front sequence at 0, 6, 12, 16, 20 and 29 seconds, front and side final photographs, and the Dream start policy view and final photograph.
visual_review.result: Demo tightens and fits the prepared knot, clears both hands and retains the fit. Dream leaves the initial loose tie unchanged.
visual_review.model_limitations: Idealized geometric grasp capture and a fixed-topology reduced tie; no full cloth or topological tying claim.

prior_refusal.reason: Dream interpreted the earlier instruction as tightening a tie on a person. The final instruction explicitly names the rigid plastic form and absence of a person; the resulting baseline completed normally.
